author: FunForLouis
description:
From wild rainforest and mountain views to a community built around regeneration, this is where we’ve chosen to slow down, put down roots, and raise our family.

What used to be cattle pasture is coming back to life, with thousands of trees planted and people from all over the world coming together alongside local Costa Ricans to build something different.

This is just the beginning Alegria village ❤️🌱
Shot on @Antigravity_Global  A1
title: This is : COSTA RICA
